query: Cross-check manifest MN-2026-07-1183 against declared cargo

executive.text: Manifest MN-2026-07-1183 declares 240 TEU of assorted electronics. OCR extraction and shipping-line records agree on TEU count; two container HS codes conflict with the shipping-line record.

criticalFindings.title: HS code mismatch on 2 of 240 containers (8517.13 vs 8471.30)

analytical.text: Two-container mismatch is small but crosses the HS-code discrepancy threshold that historically precedes reclassification for duty evasion. Recommend targeted physical inspection of the two containers only.
